description: A word counter and character counter, updating as you type. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

pageCharacters.description: Characters per standard page, counted with spaces. Default 1800: the German Normseite and Italian cartella. Pass 1500 for a French feuillet.

text.description: The text to count. Returns characters with and without spaces, words, sentences, paragraphs (split on blank lines), lines, reading and speaking time in minutes, standard pages (characters with spaces divided by pageCharacters), and the most frequent words with common ones left out, each with its count and its keyword density as a percentage of all words.

name: word_counter
title: Word Counter
